requirement: Google/GitHub sign-in from the desktop app returns to the app, and Approve on /signin works in a real browser (lane rounds included)

oracle.invariant: The /signin page sends Referrer-Policy: same-origin; the lane round becomes approved (it stayed pending under no-referrer, because Chrome sends Origin: null on the form). The approve page names Tracy Cowork for Mac and shows the same matchCode the app received; the round becomes approved. Redeem: no Origin 403; wrong secret 404 and the round stays redeemable; a lane round 404; the right secret 204 with Set-Cookie tracy_sess naming the approved account; a second redeem 404. Deny turns the round to denied.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
